---

3. Updated FunctionContract Precondition

```gsl
def improve_engineering_design(
  design: EngineeringDesignArtifactRef,
  objectives: List<Objective>,
  hard_constraints: List<Constraint>,
  comparison_policy: ComparePolicyRef,
  resource_budget: ResourceBudget,
  termination_contract: TerminationContract
) -> EngineeringImprovementCycleResult
  requires: design has no materially unresolved elements for the declared improvement scope, or those elements have a typed non-material/not-applicable disposition.
  ensures: result includes ORIGINAL, DO_NOTHING, all admitted frontier candidates, pruning receipts.
  ensures: hard constraints checked before Pareto evaluation.
  ensures: termination contract respected; non‑termination yields explicit terminal status.
  ensures: overall_status ∈ { SUCCESS, PARTIAL, INCONCLUSIVE, UNKNOWN, FAIL, TIMEOUT, RESOURCE_UNKNOWN, BLOCKED, STALE }.
  effects: [Computational, Resource].
```
